gui_sequences.steps_from: The steps are those of tests/web.browser.cjs, run unchanged inside the recorder: each step's action, expected result and checks come from that file, and every check it passes is listed with the step.
gui_sequences.reached_host: calls that failed on purpose carry reached_host: false when dropped before they reached the Web Host, true when the reply was dropped after Larkfield committed; steps_that_submit_writes counts only steps with a write or forced call whose reached_host is not false
gui_sequences.supplied_replies: replies the test supplied or changed with Playwright route.fulfill are labelled injected, relayed or altered; an injected reply carries reached_host false

outline_check.rule: Every step names the element it checks; it must be on the page and on screen, and after the screenshot the PNG is decoded and points every 3 px along each side of the outline (3 px wide, drawn just inside the element's edge so that a scrolling parent cannot clip it), leaving out 12 px at each rounded corner, are sampled: at least one side must have 8 or more points inside the image, 80% or more of them in the outline colour #d9480f (each channel within 24); a side can be off screen or covered by a neighbouring pane when the element is larger than the view

gui_sequences.capture_point: each step ends at its last check; restoring state for later steps is part of the next step, so the screenshot shows the state the step asserts
gui_sequences.reproducibility: software rasterization on one thread, screenshots with animations disabled, request IDs from a counter kept in a cookie, capture date only (the date of the run, or --captured-on YYYY-MM-DD); two consecutive runs gave byte-identical files in gui/
